name: Satty
description:
Satty is a modern, lightweight screenshot annotation tool written in Rust and GTK. Inspired by Swappy and Flameshot, it provides a fast and intuitive workflow for annotating, highlighting, and exporting screen captures.

Features:
- Annotation tools including freehand brushes, arrows, rectangles, and text labels
- Highlighting markers, number pin counters, and privacy pixelation/blur brushes
- Seamless integration with Wayland screenshot utilities (wl-copy, grim, slurp) and X11
- One-click copying to clipboard or saving directly to file
- Snappy, responsive interface designed with modern Linux desktop guidelines
